title: Microsoft Teams: Expand presenter visibility in 'Manage what attendees see' for Teams events
description: Users will now be able to resize and expand the presenter panel in 'Manage what attendees see' options for Teams events. This feature helps make it easier to view, manage, and switch between presenters during events.
